The *Saccakathā* ("Discourse on the Truths") is the third discourse of the sixth chapter (*pannāsa* / *vagga*) of the *Kathāvatthu* (Kv 6.3), preserved in the Abhidhamma Piṭaka of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. The text forms part of the debate literature of the *Kathāvatthu*, though it is not specifically analyzed or quoted within the surveyed secondary literature passages, which merely refer homonymously to the concept of truth (*sacca*), the *Sacca-saṁyutta*, or other texts bearing the name [SuttaCentral].

According to DharmaNexus, it shares 375 matching passages with 33 other Pali texts, displaying its closest structural reuses with adjacent *Kathāvatthu* debates, including the *Paṭiccasamuppādakathā* (Kv 6.2) and *Niyāmakathā* (Kv 6.1), as well as the *Puggalakathā* (Kv 1.1) and *Anupubbābhisamayakathā* (Kv 2.9) [DharmaNexus].
